uiUxIntent: Generate an original CustomCard counterpart to Adobe Express small-business thank-you example, using CustomCard structured card UX: JSON-schema card copy, editable 5x7 front panel, safe-zone print layout, privacy-safe memory notes, deterministic typography overlay, and persisted render artifacts.
benchmarkScope: front-panel-only image generation to control cost while testing updated prompt routing

requestBody.occasion: thank-you for supporting a small business
requestBody.tone: warm, sincere, polished, grateful, not salesy
requestBody.style: CustomCard small-business editorial: warm citrus, soft cream, deep charcoal, local shop texture, clean 5x7 portrait layout, generous safe margins, editable typography overlays
requestBody.personal_note: Make this feel like a real small business owner thanking a customer after a purchase, without implying an order was placed inside CustomCard.
memory_notes: The customer chose an independent small business instead of a large marketplace.
The owner wants the message to feel handmade, specific, and grateful rather than promotional.
CustomCard UX requires four editable panels, print-safe margins, human review before external sharing, and exportable/persisted render artifacts.

responseFormat: Cloudflare JSON Mode json_schema for exactly four copy panels

Target final composition is 1500 x 2100 px at 300 DPI; keep important content inside safe margins. Recipient: loyal customers. Relationship: small business to repeat customer.
